summary: V6.25.25 verification — backend pytest suite for V6.25.23/24/25 (52 tests) all PASS. Frontend smoke verified: login, Reference page Custom section, Cypher Reference Panel + Flavors sub-tab (30 cards across 8 genres, substitution copy present). Director's Console RollTableDesigner UI could not be reached in browser run due to a transient 'Summoning…' loading screen blocking the Director button click on the third nav, but the underlying backend (10/10 roll-table tests) is solid.

integration_issues.issue: Could not click the top-right 'Director' button in browser test — repeat campaign-page navigations sometimes leave a 'Summoning… The Loremaster gathers your table…' overlay that hides the chrome. Need a longer wait_for_selector on the campaign tabs (e.g. wait for 'CHARACTERS' tab) before clicking Director. Backend roll-tables are fully green (10/10).

issues: Section is labelled 'CUSTOM · AUREA' (campaign-name) rather than the literal 'Custom · Yours' from the spec — this is the per-campaign aggregation, which is acceptable, but spec wording differs.

action_items: Main agent should self-verify Director's Console RollTableDesigner via a fresh browser nav (open campaign → wait for tabs → click Director). Backend passes 10/10 so the surface-area is the click-through only.

Optionally, the verbatim label 'Custom · Yours' was implemented as 'Custom · {campaignName}'. If the spec wanted the literal 'Custom · Yours' header above the per-campaign rollup, add a single fixed heading.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend test_v62523_cypher_foundation.py uses bare 'from system_data...' import which only resolves when pytest runs from /app/backend cwd — the V6.25.25 files use 'backend.system_data...' style and run from /app. Pick one convention to avoid future collection errors.

Director button is rendered top-right on the campaign detail page but appears to vanish briefly during the 'Summoning…' lazy-load overlay; consider keeping the chrome visible or hiding the overlay only over the main pane.
